sources.title: Microsoft Foundry Models overview - Microsoft Foundry
sources.snippet: The model catalog in Foundry portal is the hub for discovering and using a wide range of models to build generative AI applications. The model catalog features thousands of models from providers like Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, Meta, Cohere, NVIDIA, and Hugging Face, including models that Microsoft trained.

sources.title: Announcing new fine-tuning models and techniques in Azure AI Foundry
sources.snippet: Today, we're excited to announce three major enhancements to model fine-tuning in Azure AI Foundry— Reinforcement Fine-Tuning (RFT) with o4-mini (coming soon), Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) for the GPT-4.1-nano and Llama 4 Scout model (available now). These updates reflect our continued commitment to empowering organizations with tools to build highly customized, domain-adapted AI systems ...
